"""Conscious: journaling reflection agent (rule-based prototype)."""
import sys,collections,re
POS={"happy","good","great","calm","excited","proud"}
NEG={"sad","bad","tired","anxious","stressed","angry"}
def analyze(t):
    w=re.findall(r"[a-z']+",t.lower())
    s=sum(x in POS for x in w)-sum(x in NEG for x in w)
    top=collections.Counter(x for x in w if len(x)>4).most_common(3)
    mood="positive" if s>0 else "negative" if s<0 else "neutral"
    return mood,[k for k,_ in top]
if __name__=="__main__":
    m,k=analyze(" ".join(sys.argv[1:]) or "I feel stressed but proud of progress")
    print("Mood:",m,"| themes:",k)
    print("Reflection: what one small step would help tomorrow?")
